_doc: Vũ Linh Đường signature items (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Prefix vl-. Unpriced proposals; sizes follow the wood, fire and soul-song-seal catalogues' grade 3-4 items. The hall also cast the Tower's tvl-eaves-listening-bell (Nhiếp Vô Thanh's, 1030) and Thu Phần's tp-autumn-grave-bell (1062); those items live in their holders' files.

items.name: Clear Bell (Thanh Linh)

effects.name: Clear Note (Thanh Âm)
effects.rule: Your ward rings when it is struck: each time it stops damage, every foe within reach is slowed for half a second (at most once every 3 seconds).

items.lore: The mistress's own bell, cast in 1150 on the night the hall was given to her, from the bronze of the bell that cracked in the pour and killed the founder in 1060. It rings a note no other bell in the south can match, and every bell line on the roads has been retuned to it.
items.build_use: The bell-caster's ward: long wards, soul resistance and a slowing ring.

items.name: Banner of the Root Line (Căn Tuyến Kỳ)

effects.name: The Forest Hears (Lâm Văn)
effects.rule: Every foe is seen from the start of a fight, and the first ambush each fight on you or an ally fails.

items.lore: A long banner of bamboo paper painted with the hall's bell lines, each bell a dot of bronze leaf. When a bell rings anywhere on the roads, its dot warms. The mistress has added a dot for every bell she has hung since 1105, and some dots are on no road the hall admits to.
items.build_use: A warning array in a flag: sight, evasion and faster Wood arts.

items.name: The Last Blue Lamp (Thanh Đăng)
items.lore: The last bronze lamp cast at Thanh Đăng Trấn before the Night Rain Edict put the Tower's lamps out (C167). Chung Thiết Liên made it in 904 and carried it south unlit in 930. His son keeps it on his tea table and has not lit it.

items.name: Bell-Caster's Apron (Chú Linh Bào)
items.lore: A leather casting apron scorched through in a hundred places. She wore it at every pour since 1030, the one in 1060 that killed the founder included.
items.build_use: The bronze pour for whoever comes too close.

sets.name: Bells on the Roads (Đạo Linh Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Line Is Tuned (Điệu Tuyến): your ward bells are linked. When any of them turns a hit, the striker gains one Slowed Time stack for each bell you hold. A foe at 5 Slowed Time stacks takes the pour: Fire damage worth your apron's attack, and the stacks are spent.

sets.story: The Clear Bell of 1150, the map of every line and the apron she cast them all in. The mistress holds all three. The line of bells inside Thu Trì's walls that no one knows of is on the banner too, and the set is how she hears it.
